title: A branch per tester: setup starts an empty branch of their own, a share pushes only there, the owner's collect reads every tester branch
request: Testers' shares on their own branches, never another's; collect rebuilds all.
plan: Share checks out and pushes only that branch.
Collect reads each branch in a worktree of its own.

decisions.decision: A tester's branch starts as an orphan.
decisions.why: The owner's store and other testers' records must never come with it.

change: dclab_rnd.testers (branch_of, _on_branch, _push to the tester's branch, collect from tester/* branches, _replay).
outcome: Two testers share at once to their own branches with no conflict, and collect rebuilds both.
lessons: Read another branch in a worktree, never by checking it out.
risks: Branch protection is the owner's setting.
